name: skylark_lookup_trip_destination
intent: Look up a SkyLark trip by confirmation code and tell where it goes
description: Opens My Trips in SkyLark Air, selects the trip matching the given confirmation code, and reports the destination shown on the trip details screen.
patterns: find my trip by confirmation code
